title: Microsoft Viva: Access Management for Copilot Analytics
description: Admins can now manage who has access to Viva Insights - Copilot Analytics, and what they can do, directly in the product. The new Access Management experience brings role assignment and permissions into one place for Global administrators, AI administrators and Viva Insights administrators, instead of managing access across Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center and in-product Manager Settings. Admins create access policies that combine a permission set, which defines what users can do, with a partition, which defines the population and datasets users can see. Policies can be assigned to individual users, Microsoft Entra security groups or, for group managers, organizational attributes. Existing role assignments continue to work, and users are automatically moved to system-defined access policies.
